figures.title: 示例查询的几个部分
figures.sql: WITH totals AS (SELECT category,SUM(sales) AS total FROM orders GROUP BY category), qualified AS (SELECT category,total FROM totals WHERE total>1000) SELECT * FROM qualified ORDER BY total DESC;

figures.title: CTE：把一个大查询拆成命名的几步，后一步用前一步的结果

tables.sql: SELECT id, category, sales FROM orders ORDER BY id

stages.label: ② 第 1 步 totals：每个 category 汇总一行（3 行）
stages.via: WITH totals AS (… GROUP BY category)：先给这一步的结果起名 totals
stages.note: 下一步 qualified 会从 totals 里筛选 total > 1000。

tables.sql: SELECT category, SUM(sales) AS total FROM orders GROUP BY category ORDER BY category

stages.label: ③ 第 2 步 qualified，再由最后的 SELECT 取出（2 行）
stages.via: qualified AS (SELECT … FROM totals WHERE total>1000)，最后 SELECT * FROM qualified ORDER BY total DESC

tables.sql: WITH totals AS (SELECT category,SUM(sales) AS total FROM orders GROUP BY category), qualified AS (SELECT category,total FROM totals WHERE total>1000) SELECT * FROM qualified ORDER BY total DESC;

figures.conclusion: 每个 CTE 都像一张临时的小表：先得到 totals，再从 totals 得到 qualified，最后查询 qualified。
